svg.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans Arabic', 'Noto Sans', sans-serif
svg.title: Qanoun architecture: ingest pipeline, Postgres + pgvector, FastAPI RAG, LLM router, Next.js web app, quality and operations
svg.text: Official Moroccan legal texts → articles → hybrid index in Postgres → grounded, cited answers in Arabic, Darija, French and English.
① Ingest — offline, once per corpus change
make ingest · every stage re-derives from data/raw/, so re-running is always safe
PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector — one database for laws, vectors and accounts
Browser ⇄ FastAPI (SSE stream) ⇄ Postgres + one LLM; retrieval works even with no LLM configured
Ask: history, scope picker, AI picker,
FastAPI backend — RAG pipeline per question
Middleware: CORS with credentials · per-IP rate limits (20 questions/min, 10 sign-ins/min) · CSRF guard
(JSON from allowed origins) · security headers · abstains with «not found» when sources don't answer
Keys live only in the server .env
measured before shipping · tested on every push · one command to deploy
GitHub Actions on every push / PR
+ prod override: private DB, local ports,
Caddy (or any TLS proxy) in front
Session tokens stored only as SHA-256
API keys never reach the browser
Accounts optional: works fully signed out
Not legal advice — the Bulletin officiel rules
